name: How long does a water intrusion assessment take?
description: Assessment time varies by property size and issue complexity, ranging from a few hours to a full day or more.

mainEntity.name: How long does a water intrusion assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a water intrusion assessment depends on several factors, including the size of your property, the complexity of the suspected issues, and the need for specialized investigative techniques. A basic assessment for a small, straightforward issue might take a few hours, while a comprehensive investigation of a larger property with multiple suspected leaks could take a full day or more. Our team will provide an estimated timeframe after an initial discussion about your specific concerns.
acceptedAnswer.description: Assessment time varies by property size and issue complexity, ranging from a few hours to a full day or more.
